description: Opt-in guards on git commit, git add and gh pr, and an opt-in restart of idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code. The hooks module checks the main thread's git commands; the PreToolUse hook checks subagents' and every call when the module did not load. Each is off until switched on in /config; with all off, neither starts python3.

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
